blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Even if James Payosing was a household name with San Beda during his time with the Red Lions in the NCAA, he understands what it means to be suiting up for the University of the Philippines in the rival UAAP even in a diminished role. With the Red Lions, he was a dynamic scorer. With the Fighting Maroons, he needs to be a spark plug. And he has no qualms in being that. “As a player, I think of this as a team sport,” he said recently as the Maroons […]...
